t: Russian MFA Spox Blasts European Hypocrisy, Crushes Baseless Accusations
d: Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova slammed European politicians for their hypocrisy, saying they routinely interfere in other countries’ affairs while warning Russia against involvement in Europe’s own unrest.

t: Kim Jong-un Honors Chinese Volunteers, Reaffirms DPRK-China Friendship
d: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un visited Dandong, China, and toured the Memorial Hall of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea on the 76th anniversary of the Chinese People’s Volunteers entering the Korean front, KCNA reported.

t: 'Ukraine Military Violated Starlink Terms of Service' - Musk on Starlink Restrictions
d: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said the Ukrainian military violated Starlink’s terms of service by using the civilian system for offensive drone attacks — and that the loophole was shut last week.

t: Russia Strikes Logistics Terminal Used by Ukrainian Forces in Kharkov
d: During overnight attacks, Russian armed forces struck the Vasishchevo logistics terminal in Kharkov used by Ukrainian forces, Russia’s Defense Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Putin Congratulates Kazakhstan President on Republic Day - Kremlin
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin congratulated Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on Republic Day and highlighted Kazakhstan's significant role in international affairs, according to a letter published by the Kremlin.

t: Russian Army Advances Across Front Lines in Ukraine
d: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - Ukraine lost over 345 soldiers in combat against Russia's Tsentr (Center) battlegroup over the past 24 hours, in addition to losses in manpower and equipment on other fronts, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Putin Calls Attempts to Accuse Russia of Inciting Unrest in Europe Clear Exaggeration
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Sunday that attempts to accuse Russia of inciting unrest in Europe is a clear exaggeration.

t: Russian-Norwegian Relations Degrade as Result of Norway's Hostile Course - Foreign Ministry
d: Relations between Russia and Norway have deteriorated in recent years as a result of hostile course taken by Oslo, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Sunday.

t: Russia Actively Sharing Agricultural Technologies With African Partners - Ambassador
d: Russia is actively sharing technology and expertise in agronomy and fertilizer production with its African partners, Russian Ambassador to Burkina Faso Igor Martynov told Sputnik.

t: One Day of Conflict Could Cost Ukraine Nearly $480Mln in 2027
d: One day of continued conflict could cost Ukraine nearly $480 million in 2027, Sputnik has calculated.

t: Russia Warns NATO Could Use New Zealand to Monitor Its Adversaries in Pacific
d: New Zealand is of interest to NATO as a potential location for deploying surveillance in the Pacific Ocean, as well as for space launches, Russian Ambassador to Wellington Stanislav Krans told Sputnik.

t: Russia's Nordgold Interested in Expanding Gold Mining in Burkina Faso - Ambassador
d: Russian company Nordgold is interested in expanding its gold mining operations in Burkina Faso, Russian Ambassador to Burkina Faso Igor Martynov said in an interview with Sputnik ahead of the Russia-Africa summit.

t: NATO Must Abandon 'Containment' of Russia to Resume Dialogue - Russian Foreign Ministry
d: Dialogue with NATO cannot be revived as long as the alliance persists in its policy of "containing" Russia, Natalia Fuzhenkova, deputy head of the Russian delegation and Russia's deputy permanent representative to the UN and other…

t: Putin: Europe Paying the Price for Own Political and Economic Mistakes
d: European leaders have only themselves to blame for growing unrest and economic problems across the continent, Russian President Vladimir Putin said.

t: Preparation for Summit Between Putin, Xi, Trump Already Underway - Kremlin Aide
d: The organization and preparation for a prospective meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin, US President Donald Trump, and Chinese President Xi Jinping, to be held on the sidelines of the APEC summit, are already underway, Kremlin…

t: Vucic Says He Expects Cooperation With Russia to Strengthen After Elections
d: Former Serbian President and head of the United Serbia coalition's candidate list Aleksandar Vucic said on Sunday that he expects cooperation with Russia to expand and strengthen following the parliamentary elections.

t: Possible Probes Into Russian Diesel Imports Would Hurt US Farmers – Expert
d: A potential Democratic investigation into the Trump administration’s diesel deal with Russia could disrupt fuel supplies to the United States, political analyst and US Republican Party member Dr. Mac Sharkawy tells Sputnik.

t: Mutual Tourist Flows Between Russia, China Increase 1.5-Fold - Deputy Prime Minister
d: Mutual tourist flows between Russia and China have increased by 1.5 times following the introduction of visa-free travel, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Dmitry Chernyshenko said on Sunday.

t: Elon Musk Calls Supporters of Prolonging Ukraine Conflict ‘Scum of the Earth’
d: US entrepreneur Elon Musk has labeled those who wish to see the conflict in Ukraine continue, at the cost of the lives of Ukrainian men, as "pieces of sh*t" and "utter scum."

t: Trump Says Trilateral Talks on Ukraine Will Take Place Soon
d: Trilateral talks on Ukraine will take place soon, US President Donald Trump said on Sunday without disclosing a specific timeframe.
